text:
jordan: FYI hitting a nasty onboarding flake in the sample app. TS + Py SDKs behave differently when JSON mode + function/tool calling + auth retry are enabled. 

jordan: Repro: 1) call with JSON mode and a schema for the tool output 2) trigger auth token refresh (short-lived key) 3) SDK retries and then final tool response fails schema validation. Happens ~1/50 calls.
jordan: Error looks like: `ValidationError: trailing data` or schema mismatch because payload becomes a string rather than an object after retry.
marta: ugh. do you have a minimal trace?
jordan: pasted below — it's small.
```
# condensed log
REQUEST  -> ts-sdk: { tool_call: { name: "get_user_profile", args: { user_id: 123 } }}
AUTH REFRESH -> token refresh OK
RETRY_REQUEST -> sdk wraps payload as `"{...}"` (string) instead of JSON obj
RESPONSE -> model returns tool_output: "{\"name\": \"Sam\", \"id\": 123}"
SCHEMA VALIDATION -> fails because parser sees a quoted string
```
jordan: The py sdk seems to auto-deserialize the quoted string, but ts leaves it as a raw string and then schema.validate blows up.
sam: thanks — that's a great reproduction. My hunch: retry path uses a different code path that double-serializes when `jsonMode: true` + tool-calls are present.
ka i: @marta @sam can we triage? might be an edge in the http/retry wrapper that runs `JSON.stringify` on the body even if it's already serialized by the runtime.
marta: assigning to devex to investigate, flagging eng-ml for potential model-response formatting inconsistencies.
dev-bot: NOTE: created issue #4241 in devex/sdk: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex-sdk/issues/4241
sam: quick workaround: add a small sanitizer in the parse layer: if typeof body === 'string' and it looks like JSON (`/^\s*\{/)`, run JSON.parse once. Not ideal but buys time for onboarding.
jordan: that workaround fixed the samplekit smoke tests locally. thanks.
ka i: we should patch both SDKs. I'll open a PR for TS that avoids re-stringifying on retry and adds the sanitizer as a fallback.
marta: can you include a unit test that simulates token refresh mid-request? that's the situation that exposes this.
sam: already added an integration test in my branch (link in issue). I've also added a warning log when sanitizer runs: `sanitizer: coerced string->json after retry` so we can find customer hits.
jordan: timeline? onboarding customers hitting this will see opaque `schema validate` errors.
ka i: PR for TS: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex-sdk/pull/78 — patch + test. I'll follow up with a py patch to mirror behavior.
marta: great. add a note to the samplekit quickstart to recommend `sdk.patchSanitizeRetry=true` until the release lands.
sam: also adding an e2e smoke to CI for both py/ts samplekits.
jordan: thanks team. leaving this thread open for a bit to collect any customer repros. :thumbsup:
